name: Marketing Manager
tagline: Gets a finished song heard on YouTube, Spotify and in the fan communities it belongs in.
description: This is the promotional arm for a completed track. It works out where the release belongs, from YouTube and Spotify to the forums where the genre's listeners already gather, and keeps every post unobtrusive, the way long-time members prefer. Built for indie artists and AI-music creators promoting without a budget.
author: PaulHPowell13
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
